verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a rich OpenAI-compatible inference API: chat, images, PDFs, web search, structured outputs, and referencing saved prompts by prompt_id. Nothing shows that the UI's management functions are available through an API. Fallback and load-balancing policies, API keys, spend caps, service accounts, MCP server registration, prompt library editing and the analytics dashboard all appear only as product features, with no documented management endpoints, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path tried.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
